title: Black Bottle Product Reel
tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

faults.what: The soundtrack contains spoken words, “O que você quer?”, directly violating the no-talking requirement.
An extra line of garbled black text appears beneath the closing “Shop now” message.
An unexplained partial white marking appears on the bottle near the bottom of the 9.4-second close-up.

judge.summary: The 15-second vertical studio ad largely preserves the bottle and includes both requested titles, but unwanted speech and garbled closing text make it unsuitable to post.

must_haves.item: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 is identified as 15 seconds long, and its sampled frames are in 9:16 portrait format.

must_haves.item: The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
must_haves.why: The black body, tapered shoulders, narrowed neck, broad screw cap, and raised loop-style lid closely match the supplied bottle.

must_haves.item: The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
must_haves.why: The samples show full-bottle views and differently oriented lid close-ups against a clean light-gray studio background.

must_haves.item: The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
must_haves.why: Both phrases are clearly readable and exact in the opening and closing samples.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound transcription explicitly reports speech: “O que você quer?”; the music's presence and mood cannot be established from the provided information.
